_doc: TTS pre-render substitution glossary for AivisSpeech (Japanese). Confirmed misreadings -> hiragana. Consumed by dr2_podcast/audio/engine.py:apply_tts_glossary (inside clean_script_for_tts). Two key classes: 'safe' (non-embeddable, plain longest-first str.replace) and 'guarded' (short embeddable keys, protected against compound-boundary false positives). Growth: add a confirmed CONTEXT-FREE misreading here (context-dependent readings 方/表/辛い/大あり live in the editor prompt + validator, NOT here). See memory 64e977ae + 68685bc7. Every value MUST NOT contain any key (idempotency invariant, asserted at load). PRUNE 2026-07-28: 15 entries removed after AivisSpeech was verified to read them correctly. Verified 3 ways: (1) isolated reading, (2) FULL-glossary vs FULL-minus-entry across every occurrence in the 14-episode corpus, (3) explicit probe of the '<ordinal>つ目の' interaction documented at tests/test_tts_glossary.py:86 — that protection lives in the 目の entry's own `guards`, not here. Forcing hiragana on correctly-read words degrades pitch accent. Archive: tts_glossary.json.archive_20260728_203604. Removed (11): 考え方, 読み方, 書き方, やり方, 使い方, 言い方, あの時, 強さ, 見方, 一番下, 元論文. RESTORED 2026-07-28 on user correction: 五つ目, 五つ, 5つ, 4つ — the numeral/counter family stays. User listening evidence (ep09 2026-07-24) is 五つ目->ごつめ. Engine reads the KANJI form correctly today, but 五つめ->ゴツメ / 五つめの->ゴツメノ are broken, and the 目の->めの rule can CREATE that partial-hiragana form; the safe key fires first (longest-first) as a second layer over 目の's guards. Restoring costs nothing: 五つ目 and いつつめ produce identical moras, so the pitch-accent argument for pruning does not apply. ADDED 2026-07-28 via Layer2 judge + systematic ordinal probe: 三つ目/四つ目/八つ目 (KANJI forms drop the small っ -> ミツメ/ヨツメ/ヤツメ; the DIGIT forms 3つ目/4つ目 read correctly, which is why this gap survived) and 中程度の下 (下 read モト instead of シタ in context; correct in isolation). ADDED 2026-07-31 from the 3-way judge bake-off (local vs Codex vs Claude subagents) over all 14 episodes: その上->ソノカミ, 人前->ニンマエ, 一時間->イチジアイダ, 間にある->マニアル, 弾く->ヒク, 三分の一/二->サンブノ..., 1,000件->センゲン, 積み上がって->ズミアガッテ, 止めない->トメナイ, 前臨床->マエリンショオ. SAFETY: 止めない was misread トメナイ in the ep01 HRT guardrail「絶対に独断で止めないでください」— the line means やめない (do not QUIT the medication); トメナイ garbles a medical safety instruction. Every entry verified against the REAL script line, not an isolated probe (isolation gave 3 false NO-OPs). ADDED 2026-08-03 from ep05 user listening feedback: 十分か->ジュップンカ. STRICTLY context-dependent — 十分/十分です/十分な/不十分/十分かどうか all read ジュウブン correctly in isolation AND in their real lines; the defect fires only when 十分か is pulled into the PRECEDING accent phrase (「何人いれば十分か」->イレバジュップンカ, ep05 L53; 「信頼区間は十分か」->シンライクカンワジュップンカ, ep13 L251). The key is therefore the 3-char 十分か, not 十分 — forcing hiragana on the 21 correctly-read 十分 occurrences in the corpus would degrade pitch accent for no gain. ADDED 2026-08-03 from ep04 user listening feedback: 五十代->ゴジッダイ. Context-dependent like 十分か — 五十代 reads ゴジュウダイ correctly in isolation and in short fragments, but in the REAL ep04 L7 line (「…ニュースですし、五十代を越えてくると…」) it collapses to ゴジッダイ; ep05's 4 occurrences read correctly today. The value is KATAKANA, deliberately: ごじゅうだい re-accents the phrase to ゴジュウダイオ accent 6, while ゴジュウダイ (and 50代) reproduce the isolated accent 2. The key stays context-free-safe because 五十代 has exactly one reading. 百五十分 in the same episode reads ヒャクゴジュップン correctly and is left alone. REMOVED 2026-08-12 on ep14 user listening feedback: BMI->ボディマスインデックス. That entry was an EXPANSION, not a misreading fix — the user wants the letters spoken. AivisSpeech reads a bare BMI natively as ビイエムアイ with moras AND accents identical to spelled-out ビーエムアイ (probed 2026-08-12 via /audio_query on the real ep14 L121 line), so no replacement entry is needed. ep14 was the only script in the corpus using it.
